subject.title: fix: stabilize room-event prompt cache mode

question: Should ambient room_event runs use a session-stable prompt/tool contract that applies the non-owner-safe owner-only Gateway tool inventory to every sender while strict effective delivery remains message-tool-only, and should the widened OpenAI/Codex Responses boundary split stay in this PR?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but it changes an authorization-adjacent tool inventory policy and the provider request shape, which are maintainer product/security-boundary choices rather than purely mechanical cache fixes.

options.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
options.body: Keep the current design, require conflict resolution plus current-head live provider/cache proof, and merge once the policy is confirmed.

options.title: Preserve Owner Room-Event Tools
options.body: Require a revision that keeps owner-only tools available for owner-sent room events and accepts or separately solves the remaining cache churn.

options.title: Split Responses Boundary Work
options.body: Land the room-event fix separately and move the OpenAI/Codex Responses boundary split to the broader #95610 track with its own proof.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof And Rebase
recommendation.body: Keep the current design, require conflict resolution plus current-head live provider/cache proof, and merge once the policy is confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the visible-reply and ambient room-event policy history from commit 1e5450f23e1c.
